subject: general
question: Which of the following nations was a part of a coalition called ‘Allied Powers’ in World War II?
solution:
The correct answer is __**USSR**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **An international military alliance **known as the **Allies**, officially known as the **United Nations from 1942**, was created **during the Second World War **(1939–1945) to combat the **Axis countries**, which were led by **Nazi Germany**, **Imperial Japan, and Fascist Italy**.
 
• The **main Allies **during **World War II **were **China**, the **Soviet Union **(after its admission in June 1941), the **United States **(after its involvement on December 8, 1941), **Great Britain**, and **France **(save during the German occupation, 1940–1944).
 
• **Allies **included all **the wartime members **of the **United Nations**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• From **1939 through 1945**, there was a **world war **called the **Second World War**.
 
• The vast majority of the world's nations—including all the great powers—formed the Allies and the Axis powers, two military coalitions that opposed one another.
 
• It started on **1 Sept 1939 and ended on 2 Sept 1945**.
